titre: WorkMaster Grouping Logic
description:
Group OperationsDefinition records into WorkMasters via a two-pass pipeline evaluated only during generation or regeneration.

First pass — Operations Definitions to Work Masters (in priority order):

  • Case 1 — Shared Physical Asset: group by PhysicalAssetID + values of all MaterialFeatureClass where IsRelevantForCoProduction = true. ODs with same asset but different relevant feature values produce separate WorkMasters.
  • Case 2 — CoProduced MaterialClass: group by CoProduced class ID. A material in N classes contributes to N WorkMasters.
  • Case 3 — Default: one WorkMaster per OperationsDefinition.

Second pass — Alternative Equipment Merging (applied to Work Masters from first pass):

  • Work Masters sharing the same produced MaterialDefinitionID set + HMAC + HMOD but differing only by equipment are merged. All equipment alternatives listed in EquipmentSpecification with quantity = 1.

titre: WorkMaster Data Model & Persistence
description:
Define and persist the WorkMaster and WorkMasterChild entities with all B2MML attributes and custom properties.

Covers:

  • All B2MML attributes: ID, Version, Description, PublishedDate, EffectiveStartDate, EffectiveEndDate, HierarchyScope, WorkType, Duration, ParameterSpecification, PersonnelSpecification, EquipmentSpecification, PhysicalAssetSpecification, MaterialSpecification, WorkflowSpecification, JobOrderSourceID
  • Cross-references: OperationsDefinitionID, OperationsSegmentID, ProcessSegmentID, WorkMasterPatternID
  • Custom properties on WorkMaster: Origin (AutoGenerated / UserDefined), PublicationState (Draft / Published), ResourceSpecificationMode (Direct / Cascaded / Aggregated), HMAC, HMOD, HLOG
  • Custom properties on WorkMasterChild: IsBottleneck, IsBookingPoint, IsPerformanceStep, JobOrderEnabled, step order
  • DB schema and repository layer

Note: DefinitionType is removed from scope — see US 151281.

titre: WorkMaster Auto-Generation from SAP (v1)
description:
When SAP sends initial Production Version / Routing / BOM data via IDocs, MES auto-creates WorkMaster v1 without user intervention.

Steps:

  1. Transform IDoc data into OperationsDefinition, OperationsSegment, OperationsMaterialBill objects (new UIDs; idempotent)
  2. Generate ResourceSpecifications (new UIDs) from segments and material bills
  3. Apply grouping logic (Cases 1/2/3/4) to determine which ODs are merged
  4. Create WorkMaster v1: Origin = AutoGenerated, PublishedDate = now, EffectiveStartDate = max(EffectiveStartDate of grouped ODs), EffectiveEndDate = null
  5. Build WorkMasterChild steps from OperationsSegments; set JobOrderEnabled = true for steps whose equipment matches the OD work centre
  6. Link WorkMaster to generated ResourceSpecifications
  7. Publish immediately; Job Orders generated only when EffectiveStartDate is reached

Relates to existing epics: 150632, features 150633, 150634

titre: WorkMaster SAP Update Handling
description:
When SAP sends updated data, MES regenerates the WorkMaster with behaviour that depends on whether the current version has been customized.

AutoGenerated current version:

  1. Regenerate OD, OpSeg, OMB objects and ResourceSpecifications (new UIDs)
  2. Auto-create WorkMaster vX+1 (AutoGenerated, published immediately)
  3. Close vX only when execution switches to vX+1 (version closing rule)

UserDefined current version:

  1. Regenerate MES objects and ResourceSpecifications
  2. Clone vX into vX+1; apply ERP changes on top of customizations; PublishedDate = null
  3. Send in-app notification to MDO user; no timeout; vX remains active
  4. MDO user accepts or customizes further, then publishes vX+1
  5. Close vX at execution switch

Relates to existing epics: 150692, features 150693, 150696

titre: WorkMaster JobOrderEnabled Logic
description:
JobOrderEnabled is the key safety mechanism that controls where and when JobOrders can be created from a WorkMaster step.

Covers:

  • Computation: JobOrderEnabled = true for WorkMasterChild steps whose equipment matches the OperationsDefinition work centre; deterministic and based on equipment matching
  • Flexible lines: JobOrderEnabled remains valid when multiple equipment/work centres exist inside one OpEquipmentSpecification
  • Enforcement: JobOrders generated only from JobOrderEnabled steps, only when EffectiveStartDate is reached, only from a Published/Active WorkMaster
  • Lifecycle maintenance: JobOrderEnabled flag preserved correctly across versioning and customization

Relates to existing epics: 150689, 150637, features 150690, 150691, 150798

titre: WorkMaster Configuration Screen (MDO UI)

  • Visualize: display WorkMaster properties (all B2MML attributes, Origin, Status, DefinitionType, version lineage) and linked OpResourceSpecifications
  • Initiate Customization: user triggers customization; system determines whether to apply in-place (inactive UserDefined) or create a new version (active or AutoGenerated)

titre: WorkMaster REST API
description:
Expose WorkMaster lifecycle operations and CRUD via REST API. This is the backend counterpart to the MDO configuration screen (epic 151078).

Endpoints:

  • GET /work-masters: list with filtering by WorkType, Status, LifecycleState (Draft/Published/Closed), HierarchyScope, OperationsDefinitionID, MaterialID; paginated
  • GET /work-masters/{id}: full object with WorkMasterChild hierarchy and ResourceSpec references (configurable depth)
  • GET /work-masters/{id}/versions: full version lineage ordered by creation date, with state per version
  • POST /work-masters/{id}/customize: trigger clone-to-draft; idempotent; returns draft ID
  • PUT /work-masters/{id}: update draft (steps, ResourceSpecs); 409 if not in Draft state
  • POST /work-masters/{id}/validate: run validation without publishing
  • POST /work-masters/{id}/publish: validate and publish draft; returns 400 with structured errors or 200 with published version

titre: Store WorkMaster custom properties: Origin, PublicationState, HMAC, HMOD, HLOG
description:
As a developer, I need custom properties persisted on WorkMaster so that publication state, origin metadata, SAP routing times, and resource specification mode are available for querying and resource calculation.

  • Origin: AutoGenerated | UserDefined
  • PublicationState: Draft | Published — persisted state set by the system whenever PublishedDate changes
  • ResourceSpecificationMode: Direct | Cascaded | Aggregated — controls how resource specifications are distributed between the parent WorkMaster and its WorkMasterChild steps. Direct = no children, specs authored on parent only. Cascaded = children exist, specs authored on parent and pushed to all children automatically. Aggregated = children exist, each child carries its own specs, parent specs are derived. Defaults to Direct on AutoGenerated Work Masters.
  • IsBottleneck (on WorkMasterChild): identifies the scheduling bottleneck step. Exactly one child per Work Master must have IsBottleneck = true.
  • IsBookingPoint (on WorkMasterChild): marks the step that triggers the SAP goods movement (backflush) on step completion. At most one child per Work Master. Falls back to bottleneck step if unset.
  • IsPerformanceStep (on WorkMasterChild): marks the step used as reference for OEE and performance tracking. Exactly one child per Work Master. Falls back to bottleneck step if unset.
  • HMAC: SAP Machine Routing Time (cycle time for CapacityMachine)
  • HMOD: SAP Operator Routing Time (cycle time = HMOD / numberOfOperators / efficiency)
  • HLOG: SAP Logistics Time

titre: WorkMaster User Customization Workflow
description:
An MDO (Key User) can customize a published WorkMaster, creating a new UserDefined version through a controlled versioning flow. No in-place modification of published versions is allowed.

Customizing an AutoGenerated WorkMaster:

  1. User initiates customization; system clones current version into vX+1 (Origin = UserDefined, PublishedDate = null)
  2. User edits steps (sequence, JobOrderEnabled flag) and ResourceSpecifications on the draft
  3. System validates draft (step sequence, ResourceSpec completeness, UID integrity, effective date coherence)
  4. User publishes; system closes vX at execution switch

Updating an existing UserDefined WorkMaster:

  1. If active: clone into new draft version; edit; validate; publish
  2. If inactive: edit in place; validate; re-publish

description:
As the system, I need WorkMaster v1 created with Origin = AutoGenerated, PublishedDate = now, PublicationState = Published, EffectiveStartDate = max(EffectiveStartDate of grouped ODs), EffectiveEndDate = null, and published immediately after creation.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • EffectiveStartDate computed as max of grouped ODs
  • PublishedDate set at creation time
  • PublicationState set to Published at creation time
  • WorkMaster linked to generated ResourceSpecifications

titre: Generate ResourceSpecification objects from OperationsSegments and OperationsMaterialBill
description:
As the system, I need ResourceSpecification objects generated with new UIDs from the transformed segments and material bills before WorkMaster creation.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • All four types created: PersonnelSpec, EquipmentSpec, PhysicalAssetSpec, MaterialSpec
  • New UIDs on each generation
  • Specs linked to their source segments

titre: Group multiple SAP Production Versions for the same material into one WorkMaster (flexible production lines)
description:
As a developer, I need the second-pass grouping to merge Work Masters that share the same produced material set and cycle times but differ only by equipment, so that SAP alternative production versions do not create duplicate Work Masters.

This is a second-pass operation applied to Work Masters already produced by the first-pass grouping (Cases 1–3). It does not operate on Operations Definitions directly.

Grouping key: set of produced MaterialDefinitionIDs + HMAC + HMOD. Work Masters matching on all three are merged. The cycle time constraint prevents merging machines running at different rates.

The merged Work Master lists all alternative equipment options in EquipmentSpecification with quantity = 1 (a list of alternatives, exactly one required). The scheduler selects the appropriate equipment at dispatch time.

Two-dimensional example: Case 2 first groups co-produced materials into one Work Master per cutting plan; this second pass then merges cutting plans that can run on alternative machines into a single Work Master.

titre: Handle SAP update for AutoGenerated WorkMaster: auto-create next version without user intervention
description:
As the system, when SAP sends updated data and the current WorkMaster is AutoGenerated, I need to auto-create WorkMaster vX+1 (AutoGenerated, PublicationState = Published) and set EffectiveEndDate on vX only when execution switches to vX+1, making vX Inactive.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • No user notification or intervention required
  • vX+1 created with PublicationState = Published and correct effective dates
  • vX EffectiveEndDate set only at execution switch (version end-date rule); vX becomes Inactive at that point

titre: Handle SAP update for UserDefined WorkMaster: create draft vX+1 and notify MDO user
description:
As the system, when SAP sends updated data and the current WorkMaster is UserDefined, I need to clone vX into vX+1, apply ERP changes on top of customizations, set PublishedDate = null and PublicationState = Draft, and send an in-app notification to the MDO user.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • Draft vX+1 created with PublicationState = Draft and ERP changes merged over user customizations
  • vX remains Active (PublicationState = Published, within effective window) until MDO user publishes vX+1
  • In-app notification sent; no timeout

titre: MDO user reviews SAP-triggered draft: accept or customize before publishing
description:
As an MDO user, I need to review a draft vX+1 created after a SAP update and choose to accept it as-is or customize it further before publishing.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • Accept path: validate → publish (PublicationState = Published) → EffectiveEndDate set on vX at execution switch → vX becomes Inactive
  • Customize path: edit steps and ResourceSpecs → validate → publish → same end-date and Inactive transition for vX
  • vX remains Active throughout the review period

titre: Clone AutoGenerated WorkMaster into UserDefined draft version
description:
As an MDO user, I need to trigger 'Customize' on a published AutoGenerated WorkMaster, which clones it into a new draft version with Origin = UserDefined, PublishedDate = null, and PublicationState = Draft.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • Clone contains all steps, ResourceSpecs, and references
  • Original published version untouched and remains Active
  • Draft has Origin = UserDefined, PublishedDate = null, PublicationState = Draft

titre: Edit inactive UserDefined WorkMaster in place without creating a new version
description:
As an MDO user, I need to edit an inactive UserDefined WorkMaster in place and re-publish it without creating an additional version, so that the version lineage stays clean for non-active definitions.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • Only allowed when Status = Inactive (PublicationState = Published but outside effective date window) and Origin = UserDefined
  • PublicationState remains Published throughout; no new version created

titre: Edit WorkMasterChild steps and ResourceSpecifications on a draft WorkMaster
description: As an MDO user, I need to edit steps (sequence, flags) and ResourceSpecifications on a draft WorkMaster, and select the ResourceSpecificationMode, so that I can adapt it to operational constraints.

titre: Validate draft WorkMaster before publication
description:
As the system, I need to validate a draft WorkMaster (step sequence consistency, ResourceSpec completeness, UID integrity, effective date coherence) before allowing publication.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • Structured validation errors returned per rule
  • Publication blocked on any validation error
  • Validation callable independently via POST /work-masters/{id}/validate

titre: Enforce Job Order creation only from JobOrderEnabled steps on an active published WorkMaster
description:
As the system, I need Job Order creation blocked for any step where JobOrderEnabled = false, and for any WorkMaster that does not have Status = Active, preventing accidental execution.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • No Job Order created from a step with JobOrderEnabled = false
  • No Job Order created when PublicationState = Draft (version not yet published)
  • No Job Order created when Status = Inactive (published but outside effective date window)
  • No Job Order created before EffectiveStartDate

titre: Compute JobOrderEnabled flag for each WorkMasterChild step based on equipment matching
description:
As the system, I need JobOrderEnabled computed deterministically for each WorkMasterChild step based on whether the step's equipment matches the OperationsDefinition work centre.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • JobOrderEnabled = true for steps whose equipment matches the OD work centre
  • Computation is deterministic and reproducible
  • Flexible lines: computation remains valid when OpEquipmentSpecification contains multiple work centres

titre: Preserve JobOrderEnabled flag correctly across versioning and customization
description:
As the system, I need the JobOrderEnabled flag maintained correctly when a WorkMaster version is cloned (user customization or SAP update), so that execution eligibility does not degrade silently across versions.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • JobOrderEnabled values carried over from source version in clones
  • User can override JobOrderEnabled on a draft without affecting active version
  • After publication, new version's flags are the authoritative values

titre: GET /work-masters/{id}/versions: list full version lineage
description:
As a client, I need GET /work-masters/{id}/versions to return all versions in the lineage ordered by creation date, with PublicationState and Status per version.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • All versions returned for the lineage
  • Ordered by creation date ascending
  • PublicationState (Draft | Published) and Status (Active | Inactive) visible per version

titre: GET /work-masters: list WorkMasters with filtering and pagination
description:
As a client, I need GET /work-masters to list WorkMasters with combinable filters (WorkType, PublicationState, Status, HierarchyScope, OperationsDefinitionID, MaterialID) and pagination.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • All filters combinable
  • Pagination supported (page/size or cursor)
  • PublicationState filter accepts Draft, Published
  • Status filter accepts Active, Inactive

titre: GET /work-masters/{id}: return full WorkMaster with child hierarchy and ResourceSpec references
description:
As a client, I need GET /work-masters/{id} to return the full object including WorkMasterChild steps (configurable depth) and all linked ResourceSpecification references.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • Child hierarchy included; depth configurable via query param
  • All four ResourceSpec types returned as references
  • 404 when WorkMaster not found

titre: POST /work-masters/{id}/customize: trigger clone-to-draft workflow
description:
As a client, I need POST /work-masters/{id}/customize to clone the published WorkMaster into a UserDefined draft, idempotently.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • Returns 200 with draft ID on success
  • Idempotent: calling twice returns same draft ID if draft already exists
  • Returns 409 if WorkMaster is not Published

titre: PUT /work-masters/{id}: update draft WorkMaster steps and ResourceSpecifications
description:
As a client, I need PUT /work-masters/{id} to update a draft WorkMaster's steps and ResourceSpecs.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • Returns 200 on success
  • Returns 409 if WorkMaster is not in Draft state
  • Partial update supported (only supplied fields modified)

titre: POST /work-masters/{id}/validate: validate a draft without publishing
description:
As a client, I need POST /work-masters/{id}/validate to run all validation rules on a draft and return structured errors without triggering publication.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • Returns 200 with empty errors list if valid
  • Returns 200 with structured error list if invalid (not 400 — validation is not an HTTP error)
  • Covers: step sequence, ResourceSpec completeness, UID integrity, effective date coherence

titre: Display WorkMaster properties and linked OpResourceSpecifications
description:
As an MDO user, I need to visualize a selected WorkMaster's properties (all B2MML attributes, Origin, PublicationState, Status, version) and its linked OpResourceSpecifications in a consistent layout.

Acceptance Criteria:

  • All properties visible including PublicationState (Draft | Published) and computed Status (Active | Inactive)
  • WorkMasterChild steps displayed in order with JobOrderEnabled flag
  • Linked OpResourceSpecifications (all four types) displayed
  • Version lineage accessible

titre: POST /work-masters/{id}/publish: validate and publish a draft WorkMaster
description:
As a client, I need POST /work-masters/{id}/publish to validate and publish a draft, returning validation errors (400) or the published version (200).

Acceptance Criteria:

  • Returns 400 with structured errors if validation fails
  • Returns 200 with published WorkMaster if valid
  • PublishedDate set to now; PublicationState set to Published
  • Returns 409 if PublicationState is not Draft

Define a Flexible JSON Structure for ISA‑95 Model Properties
description:
Our MES platform relies on ISA‑95 models (e.g. Enterprise, Site, Area, Work Center, Equipment, Material, Personnel) to represent manufacturing objects.
Currently, there is no standardized and flexible JSON structure for storing properties (attributes) of these ISA‑95 models considering new adaptations for semantic cardinality and class property type.

We need a generic, extensible, and future‑proof JSON schema that:

  • Supports multiple ISA‑95 object types
  • Allows different property types per model
  • Handles optional, dynamic, and custom properties
  • Is compatible with persistence layers (e.g. Azure SQL / Cosmos DB)
  • Can evolve without breaking existing consumers
  • Can be easily queryable

titre: [Code Review] API Layer Domain Equipement Review
description:
By reviewing the API equipement layer here my comments:

1- @YOUAZ Ichrak the getRestrictedHierarchy in service equipment function is not needed and should be removed.

From an improvement perspective:
- The current implementation is more complex than necessary
- A JOIN between Equipment and EquipmentDescription would simplify the logic
- We should avoid introducing extra methods when the same result can be achieved more cleanly

Please remove it and align with a simpler approach. @CHAABAN Nassim (NCN) is working on it.

2- @YOUAZ Ichrak  Review error handling at service layer : No Proper Error Handling / Exception Strategy -- @KHEMIRI Karima working in standard approach to be shared.

3-@YOUAZ Ichrak  Incorrect HTTP Status Codes   -- to be validated by Karima and shared in wiki

Define consistent mappings:

OperationExpected Status
POST (create) 201
GET (not found) 404
PATCH (success) 200
DELETE (success) 204
  • Use consistent response structure (or clearly documented raw responses)
4 - Reduce Crud duplication 
  • Introduce:
    • Base service
    • Shared repository helpers
  • Keep only domain-specific logic in modules


5- create function : 
@YOUAZ Ichrak 
1- The findOne existence check in the create() method is unnecessary and should be removed because uniqueness is already enforced by a database‑level unique constraint. Relying on findOne adds no safety, introduces potential race conditions, and causes extra database calls. The database should remain the single source of truth for uniqueness, and the service should rely on save() failing on duplicates and handle the resulting unique‑constraint violation appropriately.
2- Since the system has a dedicated API to display equipment data, the create() method should only return success (or the created ID). Reloading the entity with relations after save() is unnecessary and adds extra database overhead.
an example  to follow it.

create(dto: CreateEquipmentDto): Promise<Equipment> {
  const entity = this.repo.create(dto);

  try {
    const saved = await this.repo.save(entity);
    return this.findOneWithRelations(saved.id);
  } catch (error) {
    if (this.isUniqueViolation(error)) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        'Equipment with same plant, code and level already exists',
      );
    }
Note .isUniqueViolation not exist not be implemented

Remediate Axios vulnerabilities and enforce secure dependency baseline across MESX repositories
description:
As a MESX Software engineer,   
I want all MESX repositories audited and remediated for Axios-related security risks (including vulnerability ranges and known compromised releases),  
so that our services are protected against SSRF/DoS/header-injection risks and meet audit/compliance expectations.

Background / Context
Recent Axios advisories identify multiple high/critical issues across different version ranges.  
Additionally, SecOps has flagged specific compromised Axios releases that must be blocked organization-wide.  
Axios may be present as both direct and transitive dependency across MESX repositories.
Security Policy for This Initiative 
1. Organizational baseline: all MESX repositories must resolve Axios to >= 1.15.0.  
2. Explicitly blocked versions: 1.14.1 and 0.30.4 (per SecOps incident bulletin).  
3. Any Axios resolution below baseline is non-compliant, even if not matched to a specific CVE range.

Scope
1. Discover Axios usage in all MESX repositories (direct and transitive).  
2. Detect and report:
   1. Resolved Axios versions below 1.15.0.
   2. Any occurrence of blocked versions (1.14.1, 0.30.4).
   3. Transitive paths introducing non-compliant Axios.
3. Remediate impacted repositories:
   1. Upgrade dependency constraints.
   2. Regenerate lockfiles.
   3. Remove stale modules/caches as needed.
4. Validate remediation with dependency and security scans.

[Dev] BOMMAT IDOC integration
description:
### 1. BOMMAT field extraction was expanded and normalized

The BOMMAT mapping now:

- resolves `erpSource` from `SNDPOR` first, with fallback to `SNDPRN`
- trims `STLAN`, `STLAL`, `STLNR`, `STKTX`, and `MEINS`
- maps header `DATUB` to `effectiveEndDate`
- maps item `DATUB` to item `effectiveEndDate`
- resolves quantity from `MENGE_C` with fallback to `MENGE`
- sets BOM item `useType` to the MES-facing constant `Consumed`

This makes the extracted payload closer to the data actually expected by the BOMMAT service and the MES schema.

### 2. Numeric transforms were fixed to preserve zero values

The shared `float` and `int` transforms in `idoc-mapper-engine.ts` were updated so parsed `0` stays `0` instead of becoming `undefined`.

This is important for BOMMAT validation because:

- `0.000` must be treated as a real numeric value
- the handler can then reject it with the correct business-rule error
- it is no longer misclassified as a missing quantity

### 3. BOMMAT handler validation was hardened

The handler now:

- accepts only BOMMAT payloads with matching `MESTYP` and `IDOCTYP`
- throws `BadRequestException` for unsupported payloads and extraction failures
- ensures at least one `E1STPOM` item exists
- validates component material, UOM presence, UOM length, effective start date, and quantity
- rejects quantities less than or equal to `0`
- ensures the extracted payload always contains an `items` array

This moves BOMMAT handling from permissive parsing to explicit business validation.

### 4. BOMMAT service was reworked into a full transactional upsert

The service now:

- validates that the payload exists, contains items, and has a usable ERP source
- normalizes string fields before persistence
- resolves the BOM header material and all component materials explicitly
- throws `NotFoundException` when header or component materials are missing in MES
- saves the BOM header inside a transaction
- refreshes BOM items by deleting the existing set and inserting the incoming set
- links matching `operation_definition` rows to the saved BOM definition
- allows operation-definition linking failures to log warnings without aborting BOM ingestion

The most important functional outcome is that sending the same BOM header again now behaves like a true update: the BOM items are refreshed instead of leaving stale item data behind.

### 5. Entity metadata was aligned with the new persistence behavior

The BOM entities were adjusted to better match the runtime logic by:

- keeping nullable `effectiveEndDate` fields explicit
- making nullable quantity and UOM fields reflect runtime usage
- naming foreign key constraints explicitly
- keeping the unique key centered on `(materialDefinitionId, plant, useType, alternativeBom)`

## Effective End Date Behavior

`effectiveEndDate` is only populated when SAP sends a valid `DATUB`.

Current behavior:

- missing `DATUB` results in `undefined` during mapping
- `00000000` also becomes `undefined`
- the service persists missing end dates as `null`
- valid `DATUB` values are stored on both BOM header and BOM items

## Temporary Verification Performed

The simulator and spec files were used during implementation and then removed, but the following verification was completed before cleanup:

### Verification covered

- valid BOMMAT extraction and service call
- unsupported IDoc rejection
- rejection of BOMs with no `E1STPOM`
- rejection of invalid UOM length
- rejection of zero quantity with the correct business error
- rejection when ERP source is missing
- rejection when BOM header material is missing in MES
- rejection when BOM component material is missing in MES
- update-case regression proving the same BOM header refreshes item quantity
- `DATUB` mapping proving header and item end dates are extracted correctly
- HTTP envelope unwrapping for simulator-style payloads

titre: [Equipment] Manage Equipment Effective Start & End Dates
description:
Overview

Enhance equipment management by introducing Effective Start Date and Effective End Date, with clear rules depending on the equipment source (SAP vs MES X.0).

SAP-Managed Equipment
Applicable Levels
  • Area (UAP)
  • Production Line
  • Work Center

 Data Source

Dates are received from SAP via IDOC LOIWCS, segment E1CRCOL:

  • BEGDA → Effective Start Date
  • ENDDA → Effective End Date

Default Behavior 

If SAP does not provide values (fields empty or missing):

  • Effective Start Date = IDoc integration date (current system date)
  • Effective End Date = 9999-12-31

Edit Rules

  • These fields are:
    • Not editable in MES X.0
    • Only managed via SAP

MES X.0 Managed Equipment

Applicable Levels

  • Site
  • Work Unit
  • Storage Zone

New Fields

Add the following fields:

  • Effective Start Date
  • Effective End Date

These should be:

  • Available in Equipment Creation (Add New Equipment)
  • Visible in:
    • Equipment table (Tab 2)
    • “View More” details screen

Default Values

When creating new equipment:

  • Effective Start Date = Current date
  • Effective End Date = 9999-12-31

UI Behavior

  • Both fields should:
    • Use a calendar
    • Allow easy date selection

Edit Rules

Site

  • Dates cannot be modified

Work Unit & Storage Zone

  • Dates can be modified by the user

Display Requirements

  • Fields must be displayed in:
    • Equipment table (Tab 2)
    • Equipment detailed view (“View More”)
  • Ensure:
    • Consistent date format
    • Full visibility 

Date Consistency Rule

  • The system must enforce the following rule:
    • Effective End Date ≥ Effective Start Date
  • This rule applies to:
    • Equipment creation
    • Equipment update (only where editing is allowed: Work Unit, Storage Zone)
Validation Handling
  • If:
    • Effective End Date < Effective Start Date
  • Then:
    • The system must:
      • Reject the operation (create/update)

  • The following error message must be displayed:

    “End Date must be greater than or equal to Start Date”

Expiry Definition

  • An equipment is considered inactive if:
    • Effective End Date <Current Date time or  Current Date time<Efective start date 
  • Otherwise:
    • The equipment is considered Active
  • Expired equipment must:
    • Remain visible in the equipment list in case of search only 
    • Be visually distinguishable from active equipment
  • The system must apply at least one of the following visual indicators:
    • Row styling (e.g. greyed out or highlighted) in the hierarchy tab and equipment tab
    • If End Date < Current Date time or Current Date time<Efective start date 
      → Status = inactive
    • else
      → Status = Active
    • If End Date = 9999-12-31
      → Status = Always Active

    Expired equipment should:

    •  Not be selectable in new assignments of the class 
    • Remain accessible for historical tracking and visualization
  • When a parent equipment becomes inactive:
    • All its child equipment must inherit the Effective Dates
  • This rule applies to:
    • All children regardless of source:
      • SAP-managed equipment
      • MES X.0 equipment

    • Inheritance Behavior

    • If a parent (e.g., Work Center) has:
      • Effective End Date = X
    • Then all its children (e.g., Work Units):
      • Must be updated with:
        • Effective End Date = X
    • Result:
      • All children become inactive if the parent is inactive

    Cascade Rule

    • The inheritance must apply recursively:
      • Parent → Direct children → Sub-children (if any)

    =>This ensures full hierarchy consistency

    Edit Restriction Rule

    • When a parent equipment is inactive:
      • All its child equipment must become non-editable for:
        • Effective Start Date
        • Effective End Date
    A user can modify dates of a child equipment only if:
    • Its parent is active

    This rule applies regardless of origin:

    • Parent from SAP → children in MES
    • Parent from SAP → children from SAP
    • Parent from MES → children in MES

    The system must ensure:

    • No child equipment remains active if its parent is inactive
    • No child has an End Date greater than its parent’s End Date
